quest.title: Delusion
quest.description: The secret weapon and last resort of the resistance is, in fact, Delusions. Teppei's death ignites an unquenchable flame of rage within you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x30, Mora x22000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

choices.text: How could none of us have noticed?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: ...I have put out the order to seize all Delusions.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The vast majority are showing some loss of vitality, but nothing serious.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Sadly, a few have been... less fortunate...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Your Excellency, I'm planning to establish a dedicated field hospital to monitor their condition.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: The soldiers are up in arms about the ban though. They know full well what a Delusion is, but they still intend to keep using them.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Okay. I'll leave you to deal with this situation. I have to get to the front line.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: This whole fiasco is certain to be a blow to morale. If the Shogun's Army attacks now, while we're scrambling to recover, it could well undo everything we have achieved so far.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, what are your thoughts?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll go confront the Fatui directly.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: No, it's too dangerous!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The Sakoku Decree is still in force, so their Delusions must be produced within Inazuma's borders.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: To organize an operation of this scale, they will have had to mobilize a huge amount of manpower and resources. They can't have done it without local support.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: If we want to stop them, we have to destroy the factory where the Delusions are made. But it's sure to be heavily guarded...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: It's dangerous to go alone. At least take some troops with you...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There's no time for that.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Your Excellency, given the urgency of the situation, we were hardly discreet when confiscating the Delusions. The Fatui are sure to take notice.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: If we spend any longer amassing our forces, they will get wind of our plans and make their escape.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Very true. Mm... let me think...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I gave this some thought while you were confiscating the Delusions. The site of the factory must be big and secluded, but close enough to a transport route to ensure the supply of raw materials...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Not many places meet these criteria, and if we take the locations where our soldiers received their Delusions into account as well, I suspect the site is likely to be the cliffs near the ocean at the southwest of <color=#00E1FFFF>Yashiori Island</color>.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I'm not going to stop you, but please be careful.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: We have lost too many courageous fighters already. I don't want to lose you too.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Okay, let's go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? You mean, to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Delusion factory</color>?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? You aren't going to think it over first? Ugh, fine...

choices.text: He's taken a sudden turn for the worse.

talks.objective: Search for the place where the Delusions are being made
Look for the person running the factory

dialogues.speaker: The Balladeer
dialogues.text: You actually managed to find this place. Congratulations.

dialogues.speaker: The Balladeer
dialogues.text: Hah. Barely two words in and you already look like you want me dead.

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: Oh, so that's what this is about.

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: I think you've got the wrong idea. I know how this looks, but I'm just here to follow orders.

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: I'm obviously not the mastermind behind this. Aren't you supposed to be pretty tough? What are you waiting for, go get them.

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: You're getting all worked up over nothing. Pff, you've changed... You're getting weak.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How can you say this is nothing?

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: How can you call it anything more? It's the way of the world. Human life is worthless.

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: They were always going to die, with or without a Delusion. At least having one gives them a chance to fulfill their ambitions.

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: Do you have any idea how useful the Vision Hunt Decree is to us? It took a lot of work to make it happen. Obviously it was in our best interests.

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: Good news is, our hard work is finally paying off. Generating conflict creates a big market for Delusions. Now we just let the promise of power draw in the weak...

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: For just a small price, they get the feeling of controlling the world. Trading their life for supreme power... pretty good deal, don't you think?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So the Fatui started the Vision Hunt Decree? You've been behind it all along?

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: From the outside, Inazuma looks pretty impenetrable, but on the inside... it's a land of opportunity. With a little effort, we were able to break them down from within.

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: Eternity stretches things out over a long time. But each moment within it becomes all the more fragile.

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: Take your friend in the resistance, for example. There's nothing you can do now. He's a lost cause.

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: Just like a bubble on the water. Beautiful for a moment, then total destruction.

response.speaker: The Balladeer
response.text: The more it takes from them, the more tightly they hold onto it. And the more incompetent they are, the more determined they are to fight it! Hahaha, it's such a farce, you have to see the funny side.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey! {NICKNAME}, calm down...

choices.text: You're giving Delusions to the resistance...

talks.objective: Look for the person running the factory

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're another Fatui Harbinger... like Signora and Childe?

dialogues.speaker: The Balladeer
dialogues.text: Signora and Childe? Huh... I didn't know you and my two least reliable colleagues were acquainted.

dialogues.speaker: The Balladeer
dialogues.text: I'm The Balladeer, No. 6 of the Fatui Harbingers. Delighted to meet you, O Mighty Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: The Balladeer
dialogues.text: So many visitors today. To what do I owe the honor?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Teppei's breathing is getting weaker and weaker...

dialogues.speaker: Hall Notice
dialogues.text: The situation of the Inazuman civil war is presently uncertain. The longer this conflict drags on, the more advantageous our position will be...

dialogues.speaker: Hall Notice
dialogues.text: To deepen the resistance's reliance on Delusions, to fan the flames of war, and steel the resolve of the leadership on both sides to continue fighting...

dialogues.speaker: Hall Notice
dialogues.text: I call upon all available comrades to assist the work of 2nd Naval Lieutenant Nathan in dashing Sangonomiya's hopes for a quick victory...

dialogues.speaker: Hall Notice
dialogues.text: If there are any accidents, assist in 2nd Lieutenant Nathan's escape, and silence all who might reveal our infiltration into their ranks!

dialogues.speaker: Hall Notice
dialogues.text: This mission is of vital importance to securing our supply of Delusions — not a single detail may be overlooked!
